name: Lugano
description: Lake Lugano from the city's lakefront past Paradiso to the Melide causeway, Monte Ceneri, and Lago Maggiore from Locarno past Ascona to Brissago.

routesOutside.scenic-magadino-plain: Bellinzona is 14 km east of Locarno; the Magadino plain would stretch this world past 2048 nodes and the 8 MB budget.
routesOutside.scenic-valle-maggia: Cevio is 15 km up the Maggia valley north of Locarno.
routesOutside.scenic-lake-varese: Lake Varese is in Lombardy, 25 km south-west of Lugano.
routesOutside.scenic-lake-como-menaggio: Menaggio to Gravedona is on Lake Como, 20 km east of Lugano.
